editorial:
Imagine a little girl who is so scared and alone that her nightmares actually start coming true. You get to follow her as she accidentally brings a monster into the real world, but here is the twist: the creature doesn't want to hurt her. Instead, it acts like a scary bodyguard and goes after anyone who tries to treat her badly. It creates a creepy but strange feeling where you almost find yourself rooting for the monster because the people around the girl are even worse than the nightmare itself.

You will probably love how the tension builds up, and the creature design is genuinely spooky without being too over the top. Some parts of the story move a bit slow, but the payoff at the end makes it worth your time. If you enjoy dark stories about protection and revenge, you should definitely give this a shot.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the monster fully takes over to protect the girl from her abusers. It kills off the villains in a brutal way, showing that it will never leave her side. The twist is that the girl isn't scared of the monster anymore; she has accepted it as her only true friend. It ends with the girl finally feeling safe, even though she is now tied to a deadly creature forever.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves monster movies with a dark twist.
